pitches.name: Swan Slab
pitches.beta: Low-angle granite polished by every climber in Camp 4. The rope runs from the anchor above you, so a slip only drops you onto it. Keep your hips over your feet.

cruxes.name: The polished wave
cruxes.read: The wave is all feet: step high with the left, rock your hips over it, then the right hand finds the edge above.
